svg.title: Typed slip: Room 401 Went To The Bonded House and came back at 01:30.
svg.desc: A typed statement row cut into a slip and pinned to cork: "Room 401 Went To The Bonded House and came back at 01:30." It carries the green AMENDED stamp of the carbon.

g.text: ROOM 401 WENT TO THE BONDED HOUSE
